versions.name: Lewis and Clark Scout Reservation

features.note: The Lakeview Lodge provides indoor group lodging.
On the shore of Lewis and Clark Lake, part of the Missouri River.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA summer camp situated on Lewis & Clark Lake west of Yankton, operated by the Sioux Council.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The stored page is a facility-reservation page that names only coarse program areas, so the recorded codes are deliberately parent terms. Council repointed 2026-07-26: Black Hills Area Council was absorbed by Sioux Council (recorded in data/councils/_events.json); the camp had been left on the dissolved council, which resolves as a ref but is not current.
